header: THE DATE RULES OF THE "PEOPLE & EVENTS" WIDGET (step 65a; my rule, 31 Oct 2026). PURE: no database, no React; dates are Luxon, the day is the day in INDIA (Asia/Kolkata). Birthday today is the day and month of the date of birth. A birthday on 29 February is kept on 28 February in a year that has none (so it is still celebrated in February). Retirement the age is 60. The farewell is the LAST DAY OF THE MONTH in which the person attains 60 (the company fixes the last date of a month as the farewell date): born 14 Oct 1966 -> 31 Oct 2026. (A person born on the 1st is treated the same way: the month of the 60th birthday. I do NOT apply the rule that sends him one month earlier; ask me before adding it.) Silver jubilee the 25th year of service is completed in the month in which date of joining + 25 years falls; the day shown is that anniversary. Joining age nobody joins below 18; an executive who joined DIRECTLY (a Management Trainee) not below 23: their ticket is 49xxxx (the second digit of an executive ticket never changes: 9 = direct recruit, any other digit = promoted from the non-executives). A date of birth or of joining is a calendar DATE, written "YYYY-MM-DD", never a moment in time: I read it in the Indian zone so no machine's own zone can move it by a day.

behaviours: todayIST: 23:30 UTC on 30 Oct is already 31 Oct in India (UTC+5:30)
...and 18:29 UTC on 30 Oct is still 30 Oct in India
a date is read in India, whatever the machine's own zone is (no day is lost)
a date that does not exist is invalid, not rolled over
a birthday is today when the day and the month are today's, in any year
29 February: celebrated on 28 February in a year without one
...and on 29 February itself in a leap year, NOT also on the 28th of that year
a 28 February birthday is not moved
garbage is never a birthday
born 14 Oct 1966 -> retires 31 Oct 2026
born 1 Oct 1966 and 31 Oct 1966 -> the same farewell day, 31 Oct 2026 (the month of the 60th birthday)
born in February: 28 Feb in a normal year, 29 Feb in a leap year (2064)
born 29 Feb 1968 (60th birthday in 2028, a leap year) -> 29 Feb 2028
born 30 April 1966 -> 30 April 2026
born 31 Dec 1966 -> 31 Dec 2026 (the year does not roll)
retiresInMonthOf: the whole month counts, from the 1st to the last day
a person who is 59 and 11 months is not retiring this month
joined 12 Oct 2001 -> the 25th year is completed on 12 Oct 2026
joined 31 Oct 2001 -> still this month; joined 1 Nov 2001 -> next month
24 years and 25 years and 26 years: only the 25th year is a jubilee
joined 29 Feb 2000 -> 28 Feb 2025 (no 29th that year), in February
MT = an executive with a 49xxxx ticket; a promotee (any other second digit), a non-executive with such a number, a malformed ticket are not
minimum age at joining: 23 for an MT, 18 for everybody else
a fine pair passes (an MT who joined at 24, a non-executive who joined at 18 exactly)
joined the day BEFORE the 18th birthday: refused; on the birthday: fine
an MT who joined at 22: refused (23 is the minimum); at exactly 23: fine; the same age is fine for a promotee
joined or born in the future: refused
already past the farewell day (60 reached last month): refused as an employee in service
empty dates are not a problem; a bad date is reported
midnight: from noon it is 12 hours
...from one second before midnight it is one second; from midnight exactly it is a full day
...it is counted in INDIA's day: 18:30 UTC is midnight there, whatever zone the machine has
